message.content:
**Gini coefficient of the United States (most recent estimate)**  
- **Value:** ≈ 0.41 (or 41 %)  
- **Year:** 2021 (OECD estimate)  

**Context & Sources**

| Source | Year | Gini (US) | Notes |
|--------|------|-----------|-------|
| OECD | 2021 | 0.41 | Latest OECD estimate; uses income data from national accounts and surveys. |
| World Bank | 2019 | 0.394 | Uses household survey data; slightly lower than OECD due to different methodology. |
| U.S. Census Bureau | 2019 | 0.485 | Uses income distribution from the Current Population Survey; higher due to inclusion of all income sources. |

The OECD figure is generally considered the most widely cited and up‑to‑date estimate for international comparisons. It shows that the United States has a moderate level of income inequality, comparable to other high‑income OECD countries.
